svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: RaizHost cloud architecture
svg.desc: Cloudflare DNS in front of ten CloudFront distributions. Static sites are served from S3; dynamic apps run on HTTP API Gateway and arm64 Lambda; one Graviton EC2 anchor runs Postgres, PgBouncer, Redis, NAT and the client portal. DynamoDB, S3 and Secrets Manager hold state. GitHub Actions deploys via OIDC through ECR and SSM; EventBridge Scheduler, CloudWatch and Route 53 health checks operate it. Stripe, SignWell and Resend are external services.
svg.text: CloudFront Functions: canonical URLs · index rewrite · bot block
per-behavior cache policies · s-maxage edge caching
Go / Rust zip APIs · Node pollers
NAT for private Lambda subnets (no NAT Gateway)
SSM access only · nightly pg_dumpall → S3 · daily EBS snapshots
GitHub Actions deploys static sites: 4-pass s3 sync + CloudFront invalidation
Core platform ≈ $50/month · everything arm64 · idle cost ≈ $0
